scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the analytic expressions for s and A from the same public physical constants and compares the agent's numeric output within relative tolerances.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing the localization distance in centimeters.

outputs.description: Localization distance of an electron on liquid helium at T=0 for a given clamping field.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing the critical constant A in dyn (cgs).

outputs.description: Critical constant A = E²/√ρ for the square-to-triangular lattice phase transition.

output_contract.notes: Both outputs are deterministic scalar numbers obtained from analytic closed-form expressions. The checker will recompute them using the same standard physical constants and compare with relative tolerances (1% for A, 5% for s) to allow for floating-point differences. The clamping field E is now explicitly set to 3000 V/cm and must be converted to cgs units.
